metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Range ~[0,1]. Estimated by mean pairwise cosine similarity of sampled item embeddings (mapped to [0,1]). Higher means embeddings point in similar directions. This is not a measurement of recommendation diversity; null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Low-margin and wrong-rank counts are training diagnostics. Category lists are empty because category metadata is unavailable; eligible, finite and nonfinite counts are reported.
metric_definitions.training_history_dependence: Paired training-prefix diagnostics, not validation HR@10. Each prefix through t predicts the supplied positive at t against the same cached training negative. For n>=3 remove k=max(1,floor(0.2*(n-1))) recent, oldest, or uniformly sampled nonanchor positions. Keep the latest item, compact left padding and score the last retained state. Five fixed seeds separately shuffle only pre-anchor slots. Positive margin deltas mean the changed history improved separation. Every condition uses the same finite prefixes. Deletion conflates evidence removal, packing and position changes; shuffle measures item-position sensitivity. Removed-item statistics expose unmatched popularity, repetition and position imbalance. Prefixes from one user are dependent; no significance is claimed.
metric_definitions.probe_availability: Explicit availability and finite sample counts. Null estimates are missing evidence. An immutable CPU cache is built once from up to 32 public training histories with private seed 42, without reading or advancing train_loader. No validation/test data are used.
metric_definitions.probe_protocol: Diagnostic-only fixed protocol; no architecture or predictor changes, no checkpoint selection by diagnostics. Host macro validation HR@10 remains the selection criterion. No recency-residual improvement, validation confidence interval or unobserved user trait is inferred from these training measurements.
